messages:
owen: Heads-up — several customer reports where quota/charge didn’t match. Traces show old X-Access-Tier header coming from the egress route. Can we gate this quickly?

maya: Which route id and any idea why header persisted? :thinking_face:

owen: route id `egress-main-202` — looks like an override rollout yesterday left stale routing keys in the KV cache on a subset of pods.

priya: If long-lived connections keep KV refs, the old header will stick until cache invalidation or the connection resets. We need an O(1) guard that stops honoring new override tags and a short drain window to flush refs.

anil: I can push a temporary soft-guard: stop accepting override tags, rewrite the header to `X-Access-Tier:standard` at the gateway, and set a 45s drain TTL for KV refs. Want me to go now? /cc @alex (oncall)

alex (oncall): Do it. Prioritize safety — do not drop traffic. Plan: soft deny new overrides, header rewrite, monitor errors & token-cost delta for 60s, then expand rollout.

maya: Add telemetry: a header_version counter (legacy vs canonical), p99 latency delta, and a token-cost variance alert. Surface on Console -> Routes -> egress-main-202.

priya: UX note: the Console toggles today are binary. We should add a drain_seconds field so operators don’t forget to set a drain. Small UX change, big safety win.

deploy-bot: deploy started: gateway/egress-guard v3 -> staging (3 hosts)

anil: Staging applied. Toggle state: {"override_accept":"disabled","drain_seconds":45,"header_set":"X-Access-Tier:standard"}. Staging logs show ~0.9% of requests still carrying legacy header.

owen: Good. Maya/priya, validate telemetry. If no spike in errors in 2m we roll to 30%.

maya: Dashboards look fine — error rate stable. legacy header count trending down from 0.9% -> 0.15% over ~90s. Adding a quick dashboard tile for drain_seconds.

priya: Temporarily throttling override-tagged requests at 15r/s at the API layer to reduce surface area. API call used: 
```
POST /internal/override-rate-limit
{"route":"egress-main-202","limit":15}
```

alex (oncall): If errors exceed 1% OR p99 rises >20% from baseline we rollback. I'll monitor #incidents.

deploy-bot: rollout: gateway/egress-guard v3 -> 30%

anil: 30% rollout successful. Legacy header proportion ~0.03%.

owen: Nice. Let's do full in 8m if stable. Also create a short task to automate KV invalidation on route changes.

maya: Filed INFRA-783: auto-invalidate KV keys on routing rollouts. Attaching traces and the connection sample.

priya: After full, we should add a Console affordance: suggested drain_seconds computed from an in-flight estimate (based on token distributions). I’ll prototype tomorrow.

alex (oncall): Proceed with full rollout in 8m. Rollback (re-enable overrides) command: 
```
POST /internal/route-toggle
{"route":"egress-main-202","name":"override_accept","value":"enabled"}
```
Emergency kill command: 
```
PATCH /infra/nodes?action=immediate_drain&reason=egress-header-stale
```
Contacts: @alex @anil @priya

deploy-bot: full rollout complete: gateway/egress-guard v3 -> 100%

maya: Final check — legacy header 0.00% over last 3m. Closing alert and creating follow-up doc for the UX change.

owen: Closing thread. Great cross-team response. :clap:
